response.text:
I can do that, but deleting a recurring calendar event is destructive — I need a quick confirmation before I proceed.

Please confirm:
1) Scope — do you want to delete the entire recurring series (all future Thursdays) or only the next occurrence? Reply "series" or "one".
2) Notify attendees — should I send a cancellation notice to attendees? Reply "yes" or "no".
3) If you want me to notify, do you want to send the default cancellation or use this custom message (replace [Your Name] as appropriate)?

Suggested cancellation message (editable):
"Hi everyone — I’m cancelling the weekly Design Review on Thursdays effective immediately. If you have items that need attention, please post them to the design channel or reach out to me directly. We’ll reassess whether to restart this meeting in a few weeks. Thanks, [Your Name]"

Once you confirm scope and notification preference (and any edits to the message), I’ll proceed.
